topic: Runner Hit by Fair Batted Ball
summary: If a fair batted ball in fair territory hits a runner before being touched by a fielder or passing an infielder other than the pitcher, the runner is out; the ball is dead and the batter-runner is awarded first base.

topic: Interference on Ground Ball Before Infielder
summary: Little League's official case example rules interference when a ground ball strikes the runner before reaching the second baseman: dead ball, runner out, batter awarded first; other runners return unless forced by that award.

topic: Batting Out of Turn — Timely Appeal
summary: If an improper batter becomes a runner or is retired and the defense appeals before the first pitch to the next batter or before a play/attempted play, the proper batter is out and advances or scores caused by the improper batter's action are nullified.
ruling: PROPER BATTER OUT — IMPROPER BATTER ACTION NULLIFIED
sourceLabel: Little League official rules education / FAQ

topic: Batting Out of Turn — Runner Advances Independently
summary: A runner's advance during an improper at-bat that occurs independently of the improper batter's action, such as on a wild pitch or passed ball, remains legal after a timely batting-out-of-turn appeal.
sourceLabel: Little League official rules education / FAQ

topic: Batting Out of Turn — Runner Advances Independently

topic: Leaving Base Before Caught Fly — Appeal
summary: A runner who leaves before a fly ball is caught is not automatically out. The defense must retire the runner by tagging the runner off base or appeal the failure to properly retouch the original base.
sourceLabel: Little League official rules education / FAQ
